paper.title: EvoFlow: Evolving Diverse Agentic Workflows On The Fly
paper.central_claim: EvoFlow evolves, with a niching evolutionary algorithm over LLM backbone, prompt and operator topology, a Pareto population of heterogeneous complexity-adaptive agentic workflows that outperforms hand-crafted and automated baselines by 1.23%-29.86% and beats o1-preview at 12.4% of its cost with open-source LLMs.
